With the consent of Mr. Yudhvir Singh Chauhan, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State, and Mr. Gurmeet Singh Ahuja, learned counsel for respondent No. 2, the application is allowed, and CRL.M.C. 6420/2025 is taken up for hearing.
